pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: What I need is a quiet room
paragraphs: Fictional hotel complaint: lift noise repeatedly interrupted sleep; early presentation tomorrow. Earplugs are not suitable for this guest’s stated need. The first requested outcome is a quieter room, not an unspecified discount. No replacement room has yet been confirmed.

pages.title: State the problem and impact
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I’m sorry, but the room next to the lift is too noisy for me to sleep
lines.audioText: I’m sorry, but the room next to the lift is too noisy for me to sleep.
lines.translation: Desculpe, mas o quarto perto do elevador está barulhento demais para eu dormir

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’m sorry for the disturbance. We can offer earplugs
lines.audioText: I’m sorry for the disturbance. We can offer earplugs.
lines.translation: Sinto muito pelo incômodo. Podemos oferecer protetores auriculares

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Thank you, but what I need is a quiet room. I have an early presentation
lines.audioText: Thank you, but what I need is a quiet room. I have an early presentation.
lines.translation: Obrigada, mas preciso de um quarto silencioso. Tenho uma apresentação cedo

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I understand. Is the problem mainly the lift or the street outside?
lines.audioText: I understand. Is the problem mainly the lift or the street outside?
lines.translation: Entendo. O problema é principalmente o elevador ou a rua?

questions.prompt: Why is the room location important?
questions.answer: Because repeated lift noise woke the guest

pages.title: Focus on the cause
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: It was the lift that woke me repeatedly. The street isn’t the main issue
lines.audioText: It was the lift that woke me repeatedly. The street isn’t the main issue.
lines.translation: Foi o elevador que me acordou repetidamente. A rua não é a questão principal

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: That helps us find a suitable alternative. Have you already asked for a change?
lines.audioText: That helps us find a suitable alternative. Have you already asked for a change?
lines.translation: Isso ajuda a encontrar uma alternativa adequada. Você já pediu uma troca?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I did ask this afternoon, but I haven’t had a confirmed option yet
lines.audioText: I did ask this afternoon, but I haven’t had a confirmed option yet.
lines.translation: Pedi esta tarde, mas ainda não recebi uma opção confirmada

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I can check another room, though it may not be available immediately
lines.audioText: I can check another room, though it may not be available immediately.
lines.translation: Posso conferir outro quarto, embora talvez não esteja disponível imediatamente

questions.prompt: What earlier action does the guest emphasise?
questions.answer: She did ask for a room change that afternoon

pages.title: Ask for a specific offer
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Could you tell me when it would be ready and whether it’s away from the lift?
lines.audioText: Could you tell me when it would be ready and whether it’s away from the lift?
lines.translation: Pode dizer quando estaria pronto e se fica longe do elevador?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes. I’ll confirm those details before asking you to move
lines.audioText: Yes. I’ll confirm those details before asking you to move.
lines.translation: Sim. Confirmarei esses detalhes antes de pedir que você se mude

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I appreciate that. A different room only helps if it solves the noise problem
lines.audioText: I appreciate that. A different room only helps if it solves the noise problem.
lines.translation: Agradeço. Outro quarto só ajuda se resolver o problema do barulho

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Agreed. I’ll come back with a specific offer rather than another general apology
lines.audioText: Agreed. I’ll come back with a specific offer rather than another general apology.
lines.translation: Concordo. Voltarei com uma oferta específica em vez de outro pedido genérico de desculpas

questions.prompt: What must reception confirm before the guest moves?
questions.answer: When the room is ready and whether it is away from the lift

pages.title: Reach a workable solution
pages.instruction: Explain the problem and negotiate a solution that helps

pages.title: A specific room-change offer
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. Reception has offered a room on the quiet side of the building, away from the lift. It will be ready at nine this evening. They can help move the bags, and there is no extra room charge. That addresses the location of the noise, but we still need to confirm whether any maintenance work is planned nearby tonight. You have an early presentation, so the timing matters too. Would you accept the offer, subject to that check, or ask for another arrangement? Could you make clear which part meets the need and which detail is still unresolved?
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. Reception has offered a room on the quiet side of the building, away from the lift. It will be ready at nine this evening. They can help move the bags, and there is no extra room charge. That addresses the location of the noise, but we still need to confirm whether any maintenance work is planned nearby tonight. You have an early presentation, so the timing matters too. Would you accept the offer, subject to that check, or ask for another arrangement? Could you make clear which part meets the need and which detail is still unresolved?
